text: BAM routing is concentrated but broadly distributed across 16 live nodes, 374 validators, and 15 regions, with 32.01% of Solana stake routed through BAM. The largest node, ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee, holds 23.2% of BAM stake, while the busiest region is fra and the busiest node serves 93 validators. One validated structural rollover was seen on 2026-06-24 with 22 minutes of early warning; the top node changed hands 70 times in this window, which reads as churn rather than a single whale-driven flip.
